learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to feel, observe, and draw the amazing bumpy, smooth, and rough surfaces of things we find in nature!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Texture is how something feels when you touch it. A leaf might feel smooth, while tree bark feels rough and bumpy!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🖍️ The Magic of Coin and Leaf Rubbing
main_concepts.simple_explanation: You can capture texture on paper! Just put a leaf under your paper and gently rub a crayon over it. Watch the beautiful lines appear like magic.
Nature is full of tiny patterns. When you look closely at a seashell or a flower petal, you can see lines and dots that make up its special texture.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Nature Texture Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Go to the park or your garden. Find three different leaves. Put them under your notebook paper and use different colored crayons to rub and reveal their textures!

quick_recap: ⭐ Everything around us has a special texture, like rough bark or soft petals.
⭐ We can use the crayon rubbing technique to easily draw textures.
⭐ Looking closely at nature helps us become better artists!
